title: Lunenburg Tour
includes: includes an insured van and driver with commentary.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
One infant seat and one child booster seat available upon request
Non-motorized wheelchairs accepted, depending on the number of passengers with wheelchairs.
Refunds will not be issued if tour/activity is missed due to late or non-arrival of cruise ship
At time of booking, Cruise ship passengers must provide the following information: ship name, docking time, disembarkation time and re-boarding time
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Small vehicle private tour of Lunenburg, Nova Scotia. Limited to six guests. Driver is born and raised in Nova Scotia.
